relationships.subject: TRPV1 and TRPV3 antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: Several small-molecule compounds, such as TRPV1 and TRPV3 antagonists, have been developed as novel analgesic agents.

key_findings: Review of the six TRPV channels covering pain sensing, temperature sensing and metabolic control.
TRPV1 and TRPV3 antagonists have been developed as analgesics.
